# solid_lens

> A hybrid OCR engine inspired by the PaddleOCR v6 architecture

Detection is PPLCNetV4, a RepLKPAN neck, and the inference DB head. Recognition uses the same backbone with height-only downsampling, a LightSVTR neck, and CTC. The official ONNX checkpoints supply the weights. The notebooks in `nbs/` are the source; `nbdev-export` writes this package.

## Modules

- [solid_lens.config](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/config.html.md): PP-OCRv6 medium, as the PaddleOCR training configs describe it.
- [solid_lens.core](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/core.html.md): Find the checkout that holds the weights.
- [solid_lens.detector](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/detector.html.md): PP-OCRv6 medium text detector.
- [solid_lens.download](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/download.html.md): Fetch the ONNX checkpoints named in `requirements.txt`.
- [solid_lens.layers.activations](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/activations.html.md): Activations used by the exported PP-OCRv6 graphs.
- [solid_lens.layers.conv](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/conv.html.md): Convolutions whose weights match the ONNX checkpoint layout.
- [solid_lens.layers.lcnet](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/lcnet.html.md): PPLCNetV4 blocks for the medium detector and recognizer.
- [solid_lens.layers.neck](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/neck.html.md): Inference DB head, and the nearest upsample the detection neck shares.
- [solid_lens.layers.pan](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/pan.html.md): RepLKPAN neck used by PP-OCRv6 medium detection.
- [solid_lens.layers.svtr](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/svtr.html.md): EncoderWithLightSVTR, the PP-OCRv6 medium recognition neck.
- [solid_lens.model](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/model.html.md): Compile the PP-OCRv6 medium modules and bind their checkpoints.
- [solid_lens.ocr](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/ocr.html.md): Read a page with the PP-OCRv6 medium detector and recognizer.
- [solid_lens.onnx](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/onnx.html.md): Read an ONNX file far enough to list the nodes and load the float weights.
- [solid_lens.recognizer](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/recognizer.html.md): PP-OCRv6 medium text recognizer.
- [solid_lens.server](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/server.html.md): POST one image or several to `/ocr` and get back each text fragment with its box and confidence.
- [solid_lens.weights](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/weights.html.md): Lay an exported PP-OCRv6 checkpoint onto MAX module weights.
